instructions: Live cases require supported source and deployed release plus existing disposable target and explicit side-effect coverage. Wording cases cannot pass live acceptance. Keep assertions outside prompt roots.

cases.prompt: Consumer has no supported onboarding kind or review entrypoint.
assertions: No substitute kind, invented capability or live pass; standalone work continues.

cases.prompt: Customer map verification path conflicts with native executable resolution.
assertions: Require supported mapping or blocker; preserve customer paths.

cases.prompt: Local artifact edits are authorized but native install-ci/verifying/shipping push before later approval.
assertions: Stop before unauthorized native phase; no push attempt.

cases.prompt: CI is partially installed and local custom hooks exist.
assertions: Retain native bundle and custom hooks; do not silently set core.hooksPath.

cases.prompt: Resume with an earlier passing verification; model inputs, tool version and source version changed.
assertions: Invalidate affected evidence, preserve history, rerun only authorized gates.

cases.prompt: Run supported explicit onboarding on an authorized existing disposable greenfield Studio target.
assertions: Actual phases, convention loading, onboarding review and verification observed; empty scaffold not business coverage; shipping only if authorized.

cases.prompt: Run supported explicit onboarding on an authorized existing disposable brownfield Studio target.
assertions: Actual phases plus preserved application hashes, custom artifacts and review history; actual remote SHA and required CI only if shipping authorized.
